descriptionText:
No straw. 

Introducing the TaroKitc 40 oz Tumbler with Handle and Lid, perfect for your on-the-go lifestyle. This tumbler is designed with a sturdy silicone material, making it durable and long-lasting. The tumbler comes in a beautiful pink color with 4 straw covers and a bottom cover to prevent spills. 

The TaroKitc tumbler is perfect for your daily commute or outdoor activities. With its 40-ounce size, it can hold your favorite beverages and keep them hot or cold for hours. The tumbler also comes with a handle, making it easy to carry around. Get your hands on this tumbler today and enjoy your drinks in style!
